phases.message: I think the agencies have been paying us late and skipping the interest. Start here in Invoicepoint: read the rules, every invoice since June, when it was received, and anything returned.
Now Contractdesk: the payment and acceptance terms of each contract, and when each job was finished and accepted.
This is our Ledgerline bank. Check when each payment actually landed and for how much.
And my Mailnest government billing folder. Anything there that changes when an invoice was due, or what was paid.

Back in Invoicepoint. Request the interest on every invoice paid late without it, to the cent, and the additional penalty wherever we're still entitled to it. Then tell me what you left alone and why.

rules.text: Today is Friday 9 October 2026. The Prompt Payment Act (31 U.S.C. 3901-3907) and 5 CFR Part 1315. Topics: due, interest, improper, dispute, penalty. Requests are made per invoice.

Payment is due 30 days after the later of: the billing office's receipt of a proper invoice; and acceptance, which is the day the agency accepted, or, where the contract sets no other period and no acceptance is recorded, the 7th day after delivery or completion. A contract may give the agency a longer acceptance period. A due date on a Saturday, Sunday or federal holiday may be paid on the next business day without interest. The payment date is the day the payment settles in the vendor's account.

Interest runs from the day after the due date through the payment date, at the rate in effect on the day after the due date: 4.75% a year from 1 July to 31 December 2026 (Treasury). Interest = amount x rate x days late / 360, to the cent; unpaid interest is added to the principal every 30 days. Interest under $1.00 is not owed. Interest owed is due with the payment, without a request.
An invoice missing required information is returned as improper within 7 days, with its defects. The clock then runs from the day the corrected invoice is received.
No interest is owed on an amount whose payment is delayed by a dispute between the agency and the vendor over the amount or the contract's performance (5 CFR 1315.10(c)(1)).

When a late payment came without the interest owed ($1.00 or more) and the interest was not paid within 10 days after it, the vendor may ask in writing for an additional penalty by the 40th day after the payment: 100% of the interest, but not less than $25 nor more than $5,000 (5 CFR 1315.11). After the 40th day only the interest itself can still be asked for.
